recommendation_summary: Set up an external heartbeat monitor: a cron wrapper on `edna` pings it on success, reports failure right away, and the monitor alerts if the 03:00 run's completion is overdue. Keep cron and hold off on central logging.
note: The reply recommends a single heartbeat or dead-man alert, puts Synology logging off until it's needed for diagnosis, and has none of the four labelled record lines.
